{{recipe}}| [[Cookbook:Middle Eastern cuisines|Middle Eastern Cuisines]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Turkey|Turkish Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Eggs|Egg Dishes]]

'''Menemen''' is a Turkish dish of eggs with onion, green pepper and tomato.  It can be served as a breakfast or luncheon dish.

==Ingredients==
*4 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|green peppers]]<ref>Red peppers may also be used, alone or in combination with green, yellow or orange ones.</ref>
*4 [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]]
*2 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
*1–2 tsp [[Cookbook:Oregano|dried oregano]] (optional)
*1–2 tsp [[Cookbook:Paprika|sweet paprika]] (optional)
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] 
*[[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]]

==Procedure==
# Prepare a ''[[Cookbook:Tomato Concassé|concassée]]'' of tomatoes by blanching, peeling, seeding and dicing the tomatoes. Alternately, you may simply grind the tomatoes in a [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]] or grate them using a box [[Cookbook:Grater|grater]].
# [[Cookbook:Dice|Dice]] the onions and peppers in medium dice and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] in the olive oil until tender.
# Add the oregano and paprika, if using.
# Add the tomatoes to the peppers and onion and cook for 5 minutes.
# Add the parsley and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
# Beat the eggs and pour over the mixture in the pan. Stir until cooked.
# Serve with Turkish bread.<ref>A crisp baguette is a good substitute.</ref>

==Notes==
